claims: The March 2026 Producer Price Index (PPI) showed a 0.5% monthly increase.
The March 2026 monthly PPI increased 0.5%, below the estimated 1.1%.
The March 2026 annual headline PPI rose to 4.0%.
The March 2026 annual headline PPI marked the highest gain since February 2023.
The March 2026 core PPI (ex-food/energy) increased 0.1% monthly.
The March 2026 core PPI increased 3.8% annually.
The March 2026 core PPI monthly increase was less than the expected 0.5%.
March 2026 service prices were unchanged on the month.
The April 2026 PPI report is scheduled for release by the Bureau of Labor Statistics on May 13, 2026.
